scope: Read-only source and current scheduling/evidence snapshot; no account execution, no source changes, no cache changes.
reasoning: The resource addendum is publicly published before the boundary cache moves or the extra account pool starts; the original research protocol retains its original hash.
The forward runner checks the C0307 cache before loading any tail request. The cache is currently held while the tail runs, so the forward loop cannot reach any tail center.
The extra runner owns center ordinals72..98 only. It writes33 scenarios per center to center-specific checkpoint files and requires all27*33 publications before restoring C0307.
After restoration, the forward runner reads completed result coordinates and constructs an empty pending set for the tail; it does not rerun these accounts.

Public account evidence publication uses per-content-hash immutable paths, UUID temporary files and atomic hard links, rather than a shared mutable experiment index. The two parent publishers do not contend on per-center checkpoint paths.
Each pool uses its existing8-worker and1-native-thread contract. Evaluation and publication worker pools are sequential within each parent; the aggregate active pool budget is16.

Failure keeps the cache held and emits a failure record. Final checks require tail COMPLETE,891 scenarios, restored cache and absence of the failure marker; publisher also gates completion and includes the resource evidence.
operational_conditions: This is a one-run dispatch barrier, not a general interprocess lock. While the cache is held, do not rerun prepare_plans.py for C0307, regenerate its cache, manually restore the cache, or launch another runner for these candidate sets.

The startup active-index assertion precedes the cache rename and is not an atomic general scheduling lock. Current observed dispatch has already acquired the cache before the forward boundary; do not reuse this pattern at an already-active boundary.
After a tail failure, reconcile published evidence and checkpoint state before any retry or cache restoration; the script deliberately does not silently resume partial tails.
